doc.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Touring South America and India with Buddy Rich
summary: Carnival and Copacabana in Brazil and a mosquito tent in India where Rich praised his time.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: It must have been interesting to tour the whole world.
Is there any place that you went to that really sticks out in your mind?

Let me see. Well South America, that was great, like a thrill, especially when you’re young and you see all these places, and I think maybe the carnival thing was going on but it just seemed so romantic and beautiful weather and women and everything. A great place. I think we were at the Copacabana like overlooking the beach. And the bossa nova was just kind of becoming popular and it was so beautiful. So that kind of sticks out. And I remember being in the tent with Buddy, in India, where they have these things to keep out the mosquitoes or whatever, and being in a tent with me and someone else over there. I guess he was getting stoned, and I had this little melodica and I was playing different things and everyone was breaking up and laughing. And I remember Buddy told me he says, “You have such great time,” which was a nice little—
